# NYC Public Schools

> > Official directory and information portal for New York City Department of Education (NYC DOE) public schools, charter schools, and early childhood programs across all five boroughs.

Schools.nyc.gov provides comprehensive profiles for NYC public schools, charter schools, Pre-K centers, and childcare facilities. Each profile includes school performance data, enrollment information, and links to MySchools.nyc for applications and the School Quality Snapshot dashboard.

## Key Topics

- NYC DOE (New York City Department of Education)
- MySchools.nyc
- School Quality Snapshot
- School Performance Dashboard
- Charter schools
- Pre-K and 3-K programs
- NYCEEC (NYC Early Education Centers)
- Geographic districts
- Five boroughs (Bronx, Brooklyn, Manhattan, Queens, Staten Island)
- Elementary schools
- Early childhood education
- School enrollment and applications
- Public school profiles

## Charter Schools

- [Success Academy Charter School - NYC 7](https://www.schools.nyc.gov/schools/X886): Success Academy Charter School NYC 7 profile in Bronx
- [Amber Charter School Kingsbridge](https://www.schools.nyc.gov/schools/X592): Amber Charter School Kingsbridge K-8 profile in Bronx
- [Manhattan Charter School II](https://www.schools.nyc.gov/schools/M080): Manhattan Charter School II profile on Henry Street

## Pre-K Centers

- [District 30 Pre-K Center at 27-35 Jackson Avenue](https://www.schools.nyc.gov/sitefinity/status?ReturnUrl=https://www.schools.nyc.gov/schools/Z119): District 30 Pre-K Center profile in Queens at Jackson Avenue

## Early Childhood Care and Education

- [Lil Inventors Child Care- Wallace Ave](https://www.schools.nyc.gov/schools/XBAZ): Lil Inventors childcare center profile on Wallace Ave, Bronx
- [Okie Dokie Day Care](https://www.schools.nyc.gov/schools/KCNW): Okie Dokie daycare profile in Brooklyn District 20
